title: ACTREC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Pharmacist, Assistant Medical Social Worker Posts
description: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) has officially released the notification for the recruitment of 02 Pharmacist and Assistant Medical Social Worker Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B. Pharm, D. Pharm, or Post Graduation can use this chance and apply for the ACTREC Notification 2026 .
